column1: #   - n_genes_bound: number of distinct panel genes with at least one qualifying ChEMBL activity (IC50/EC50/Ki/Kd, nM) for this compound, AT ANY POTENCY.
#   - n_genes_bound_pchembl_ge6 / n_effectors_bound_pchembl_ge6: the same counts gated to pchembl_value >= 6 (<= 1 uM), the conventional 'active' cut. Rows are sorted by this gated count first.
#   - best_pchembl: the highest pchembl_value (-log10 molar potency) observed for this compound across any bound gene; higher = more potent.
#   - genes: comma-separated SYMBOL:<best pchembl for that gene> pairs, 'NA' where an activity exists but no pchembl_value was computed.
#   - This is NOT a CTD-style literature co-occurrence count - it is measured binding/functional affinity data.
#   - Absence from this file means the compound had no qualifying ChEMBL activity against ANY of the 43 panel genes - it does not mean no interaction exists.

#   - An UNGATED 'bound' (n_genes_bound) can be as weak as >100 uM - it only means ChEMBL recorded a qualifying IC50/EC50/Ki/Kd measurement, not that it is a meaningful binder. Use the pchembl_ge6 columns for potency-aware ranking.
#   - Rows lacking a pchembl_value for a gene ('NA' in the genes column) are EXCLUDED from the gated counts - this is missing/unconverted unit data, not evidence of weak binding.
# SOURCE: ChEMBL REST API (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chembl/api/data), live pull.
# WARNING: absence of a ChEMBL activity for a gene/compound pair means "not measured in ChEMBL", NOT "no interaction".
